elsewhere.note: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?
Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?
Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh; so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on Ephraim. Judah will plow. Jacob will break…
